title: Balloon Eustachian Tube Dilation
desc: OR procedure under general anesthesia that dilates a dysfunctional eustachian tube using an inflatable balloon catheter.

blocks.content: MA setup for balloon eustachian tube dilation

This is an OR procedure performed under general anesthesia. The MA's role is pre-op preparation and documentation, not intraoperative setup. Refer to the Pre-Op protocol for general surgical preparation. No additional in-office instrument setup is required beyond the standard pre-op checklist.
